note: On profile he is close to the textbook case: runs and will inherit a family elevator business with real estate holdings and personally operates a boutique hotel; health is the one neglected area after a good 14-month run; and the ask is explicitly good to great — "my body looks good, except for that part." He is also plainly not the deconditioned exclusion at 80 kg and 178 cm training three times a week, so not_deconditioned holds. The single miss is income as the ICP tests it — willingness to pay — where he priced the engagement at $2,000-2,500 and called $6,000 "way above my budget." Same shape as the Badrane Hriouch assessment: fits on profile, not on price expectation. Capacity may well exist behind the asset base, but no financial-picture work was done to establish it.
